scripts.docs:gen: bun run docs:cli && bun run docs:config && bun run docs:crates
scripts.docs:cli: cd .. && cargo run -q -p bupha -- gen-cli-docs > docs/reference/cli.md
scripts.docs:api: cd .. && cargo doc --workspace --no-deps && mkdir -p docs/public/api && rm -rf docs/public/api/* && cp -r target/doc/* docs/public/api/ && python3 docs/gen-api-index.py docs/public/api/index.html
scripts.docs:deploy: bun run docs:api && bun run docs:build && bunx gh-pages -d .vitepress/dist
